name: a floating slider tunes the scene's light live
looks: A small frosted glass pill floats low in the frame, labelled with a lighting preset and a value. As a cursor drags its handle along the track, the value climbs and the photo above it visibly warms, the light growing softer and more golden in step with the slider.
build: The slider's handle x and value text are driven off one clock value (power2.inOut); the photo's colour grade (a CSS filter stack: warmth, exposure) keys off that identical value so the image and the slider move in lockstep, same mechanic as slider-scrub-preview.
sound: A soft tick per slider step and a light shimmer as the grade resolves.
prompt: Float a small frosted control over a generated photo, naming a lighting preset, and drag its slider while the photo's light visibly warms in exact step with the value, so the parameter and the image read as one live, tunable thing.
